findings.issue: Data corruption: deletes ALL faculty course qualifications across the system instead of scoping to the current submission
findings.evidence: FacultyCourseQualification.query.filter_by(faculty_id=user.id).delete() removes all qualifications for the faculty member. This table is shared infrastructure used by the scheduler (app.py line 321) and populated by CSV import (init_db.py line 626). It has no semester_id or submission_id field (models.py line 320-323).
findings.consequence: When faculty submit preferred courses, their qualification data used by the scheduler is destroyed. This breaks faculty-to-course matching in schedule generation. Multiple concurrent submissions could corrupt each other's data.
findings.correction: Create a new PreferredCourse model with submission_id foreign key (like AvailabilitySlot). Delete scoped to submission_id: PreferredCourse.query.filter_by(submission_id=sub.id).delete(). Leave FacultyCourseQualification untouched.

findings.correction: Query PreferredCourse.query.filter_by(submission_id=sub.id) after creating the PreferredCourse model
